diagnosis: The view uses simple-history's as_of() method to retrieve a point-in-time snapshot of FinancialStatement by statement_id. It queries the historical model directly without scoping by company or user ownership, allowing any authenticated caller to read past confidential earnings drafts and ledger balances.
exploit_request:
GET /api/finance/statements/492/snapshot/?as_of=2024-03-31T23:59:59Z HTTP/1.1
Host: treasury.platform.org
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
